claims.object_text: no difference in basal activity of granule cells between genotypes
claims.quote: Both genotypes demonstrated similarly sparse c-fos and ΔFosB expressions within the hippocampal dentate granule cell layer (GCL) at baseline, consistent with no difference in basal activity of granule cells between genotypes.

claims.object_text: fewer c-fos-positive cells but dramatically increased ΔFosB expression in the dentate gyrus compared with WT mice after handling-associated convulsions
claims.quote: Surprisingly, when mice were assayed 1 h after handling-associated convulsions, KO mice had fewer c-fos-positive cells but dramatically increased ΔFosB expression in the dentate gyrus compared with WT mice.

claims.object_text: increased c-fos expression in dentate after subthreshold pentylenetetrazol
claims.quote: After administration of a subthreshold pentylenetetrazol dose, however, KO mice dentate had significantly more c-fos expression compared with WT mice.

claims.object_text: other histopathological markers of TLE were similar between WT and KO mice
claims.quote: Other histopathological markers of TLE in these mice, including markers of neurogenesis, glial activation, and mossy fiber sprouting, were similar between WT and KO mice,

claims.object_text: small but statistically significant increase in hilar mossy cell density
claims.quote: apart from a small but statistically significant increase in hilar mossy cell density, opposite to what is typically found in mice with TLE.

claims.object_text: altered functional properties of the network without associated structural changes in the hippocampus at the typical age of seizure onset
claims.quote: the differences in seizure-associated dentate gyrus function in the absence of α2δ-2 protein are likely due to altered functional properties of the network without associated structural changes in the hippocampus at the typical age of seizure onset.
